advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Escape `|` (and strip/replace newlines) in tool summaries before inserting them into the markdown table cell in `_render_row`.
evidence: scripts/gen_mcp_reference.py `_render_row`: `return f"| `{name}` | {cell} |"` — `cell` is the raw summary with no `|` escaping
src/rebar/_mcp_writes.py:170: `"""Link two tickets (one of the six canonical relations: blocks |` — first docstring line ends in a raw pipe
docs/mcp-reference.md:62: `| `link_tickets` | Link two tickets (one of the six canonical relations: blocks | |` — the stray `|` splits the cell into an extra column, rendering broken on GitHub
advisory.finding: Tool summaries are inserted into markdown table cells without escaping the pipe character, so a docstring first line containing `|` (link_tickets: 'blocks | depends_on | ...') produces a malformed table row.
scenarios: Any MCP tool whose first docstring line contains a `|` (e.g. link_tickets listing the six relations)
advisory.suggested_fix: In `_render_row`, escape pipes in the summary and annotation, e.g. `cell = cell.replace('|', '\\|')` before building the row.
